profile.name: Deenadayalan K
profile.title: Software Engineer — AI & Data Platforms
profile.availability: Serving notice — available to join from 29 Dec 2026
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 3+ years building an enterprise ETL and data-validation platform in Python, Node.js, FastAPI, Pandas and RabbitMQ. Reconciled 50 million rows with zero differences on a single machine, shipped an OpenAI feature that turns plain-English business rules into Pandas code, and built an MCP server with Claude Code that lets users operate the platform through chat. Promoted to Software Engineer in April 2026; now building agentic, LLM-powered tools on data platforms.

experience.project: Travis — enterprise low-code ETL and data-testing platform
bullets: Built a hash-partitioned reconciliation engine (RabbitMQ queues + Python workers) that scaled from failing under 1GB to comparing two 75GB files in ~7 hours on one 16GB machine (proof of concept).
Benchmarked the platform at 50M rows: loaded CSV into MongoDB at ~52,800 rows/sec and reconciled every row across CSV, DAT, MongoDB and Hive with zero differences.
Shipped an LLM feature (OpenAI API) that converts plain-English business rules into Pandas expressions, so non-developers build transformations without code.
Built an MCP server for Travis using Claude Code and connected it to the Terra-Sentinel chat interface, so users run platform operations in natural language.
Fixed RabbitMQ dropping validation workers under load, traced through broker logs; a 50M-row DAT-to-Hive validation went from stalling at 17–74% to 100% complete.
Delivered a Python (Pandas, Dask) utility for a client requirement that reconciles DAT and CSV files cell by cell, handling files up to 2GB.
Migrated the core transformation engine from Node.js/Formula.js to a Python microservice (Pandas, FastAPI).
Migrating the legacy UI to the new Terra-Sentinel Angular 20 interface (standalone components, signals), using Claude Code for AI-assisted development and refactoring.
Designed message-driven execution — custom Node-RED nodes wired through RabbitMQ to Python workers — running pipelines independently of the central server and ending bulk-load memory crashes.
Built a metadata-driven data-quality framework (duplicate, null, format checks) and a General Ledger validation engine that evaluates user-defined rules into Pass/Fail results.
Led R&D of the Joiner node for large-dataset joins; streamed live pipeline status to the Angular dashboard over WebSockets.
rd: Evaluated Apache Ignite and Trino as federated query engines for heterogeneous joins, testing cross-source joins on 1GB of Oracle and MongoDB data.
Compared Dask, Apache Spark and RabbitMQ-based worker queues for scaling ETL processing beyond a single machine; RabbitMQ worker queues were adopted in the platform.
Built a gRPC dataflow prototype as an alternative to REST APIs and WebSockets for moving data between services; after comparing it with RabbitMQ, RabbitMQ was selected for the platform.
Evaluated React Flow and shadcn/ui for a next-generation visual pipeline builder.
Analysed Next.js, Go and Rust backend structures for a next-generation platform architecture, including a Go API layer and a Rust execution worker.

bullets: Built a hospital and patient management system (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js) with REST APIs, authentication and role-based access control.
Migrated an enterprise Angular application from Angular 8 to 14, rewriting legacy code for newer npm packages and modernising the UI.

earlierExperience.detail: Collected and analysed vibration data from industrial rotating equipment to detect faults, and wrote diagnostic reports with predictive-maintenance recommendations to reduce downtime.
Supported operations and maintenance teams with inspection, troubleshooting and installation of industrial machinery.
Installed and configured billing software, POS systems, kiosks and Windows systems at retail and hotel client sites.

projects.name: CuraSynk
projects.description: A 100% private, offline-first Android app for managing family health records, medical histories and medication reminders — no cloud, no servers, every byte stays on-device. Built end-to-end solo: architecture, UI, local notifications and release signing.
highlights: Family member profiles with individual medical history & condition tracking (cured / ongoing / not medicated)
Smart medication alarms via timezone-aware local notifications
In-app PDF/image document viewer with pinch-to-zoom
App PIN + security-question recovery, encrypted local backup/restore
Released as signed APK + Play Store AAB (v1.0.1) — currently in closed testing, available here as a direct APK while it clears Google's 12-tester requirement

No-code workflow for non-technical data stewards
